episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence discusses innovative financial strategies for real estate agents to help clients leverage their existing properties. Key topics include converting homes into rental properties, using bridge loans to eliminate contingencies, and streamlining loan processes with AI. These insights empower agents to unlock new opportunities for clients feeling constrained by low mortgage rates.
